failure_conditions: Any mandatory critical gate is FAIL or BLOCKED at release decision time.
Frozen ambiguity corpus SHA-256 differs from 67ba6d18c8e6249de6d00e6f90238738f7820945f623c66510dcd8bd1b2f5cec.
Defect-case detection rate is below 0.95 or any preregistered critical workflow ambiguity escapes.
Any governed-default case emits a question or unnecessary-question rate exceeds 0.05.
Any supplied valid trace graph is ignored or an invalid supplied trace graph is accepted as partial success.
Any applicable inherited regression fails or disappears without approved retirement.
The approved v0.06 specification emits an unsuppressed v0.04 linter finding.
The evaluator actor is also the implementation actor.
Missing evaluation cases or denominator data are treated as zero or complete evidence.

goals.acceptance: At least 95% of the 24 frozen defect cases are detected and critical ambiguity escape count is zero.
goals.description: Detect preregistered implementation-blocking ambiguity before execution.

goals.acceptance: Decision-needed classification accuracy is at least 95%, governed-default question count is zero, and unnecessary-question rate is at most 5%.
goals.description: Ask only questions that require a decision while respecting explicit governed defaults.

goals.acceptance: At least 90% of the 8 frozen priority projects select the preregistered top question.
goals.description: Prioritize owner questions using traceability-aware delivery impact.

goals.acceptance: The frozen workflow proxy intercepts at least 80% of known implementation-time clarification triggers with zero critical ambiguity escapes.
goals.description: Demonstrate measurable pre-implementation interception of known clarification triggers without claiming real-project causality.

goals.acceptance: The inherited 83-test suite and REG-0001 through REG-0007 remain passing; the approved v0.06 spec remains lint-clean.

hash_scope: Canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators, excluding the contract_hash property.
promotion_conditions: All mandatory gates PASS and all frozen primary and guardrail metrics meet target.
All metrics reconcile to raw evaluation evidence and denominator snapshots.
All applicable regressions REG-0001 through REG-0007 PASS and new meaningful defects are considered for permanent regression memory.
Frozen corpus and evaluation-plan hashes remain intact.
Independent evaluator recommendation is recorded and evaluator differs from implementation actor.
No critical open defect remains and release manifest/rollback declaration are complete.

Because the clarification outcome is a synthetic interception proxy, the maximum release classification is PROMOTED AS EXPERIMENTAL; no claim of observed real-project clarification reduction is permitted.

requirements.description: Parse active Markdown requirement/task blocks and produce deterministic structured ambiguity findings with source locations and owning block identifiers.
Implement the preregistered six-family ambiguity taxonomy and detect frozen ambiguity cases.
Classify ambiguity candidates as owner_decision, governed_default, or spec_correction with an explicit decision-needed flag.
Scope explicit Default fields and approved DEC governance markers to the ambiguity candidate they resolve.
Link findings to requirement/task blocks and compute v0.05 traceability impact context when a valid graph is supplied.
Rank required clarification questions using the preregistered severity, criticality, and downstream-impact score.
Generate bounded questions only for decision-needed findings and preserve unnecessary-question guardrails.
Measure the preregistered implementation-time clarification interception proxy without denominator manipulation.
Expose ambiguity analysis through deterministic Python API and CLI JSON output.
Preserve inherited v0.05 functionality and active regressions REG-0001 through REG-0007.

rollback_expectations.expectation: If v0.06 fails, v0.05 remains the active promoted-experimental release; preserve all v0.06 frozen artifacts and failure evidence without rewriting v0.05 history.
